GRCh38.p14_project_reference.evidence: The checkpoint used extended hg38 training intervals. Exact GRCh38.p14 patch and contig differences must be validated.

GSE289173_reference_allele_windows.evidence: Human reference windows are the declared pretraining corpus; exact locus membership can be derived from the frozen BED and extension algorithm.

GSE289173_observed_variant_alleles.evidence: The corpus used the reference genome and did not declare population haplotypes.

GSE289173_eQTL_ieQTL_effects.evidence: The checkpoint was released before GSE289173 became public and was trained without eQTL labels.

long_range_eQTL_VEP_labels.evidence: The Caduceus study extracted frozen embeddings and fit an SVM on the published long-range eQTL variant classification task. The fitted SVM is not part of this checkpoint.

task_data_gate.sealed_rule: GSE289173 cannot choose context length, pooling width, layer, RCPS aggregation, calibration, or head parameters.
